text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Sion. My, my, you're working 
hard out here~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I can't believe she's bounced 
back already. She seemed pretty down in 
the dumps yesterday...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That mock race between those two... They 
shoved it right in our faces.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "......Huh? Come to think of it, yeah."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I bounced back pretty fast this time, or 
rather... Usually, I'd still be totally 
bummed out around now.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Maybe... this is all thanks to you, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
They told me, y'know? "Learn how to be 
good at feeling down."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"So, I figured I'd make better use of the 
time I spend blaming myself instead. Not 
really sure if this is the right answer, 
though."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I see... Sounds like you've found yourself 
a fine Trainer, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. I gotta treasure this, for sure.

One day, as I was taking care of some 
miscellaneous tasks in the Trainer's 
Room...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Good work! Um, here... please take this.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No particular reason! ...Well, I mean, 
maybe not completely nothing... yeah.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I just wanted to give it to you, is all.
